dedupe_keys.name: topologie des parcs relais du reseau star

description: STAR publishes the locations and capacities of park-and-ride facilities in the Rennes network. Fields distinguish total spaces, solo drivers, carpool users, people with reduced mobility, electric vehicles and reserved service spaces. The schema also provides commissioning dates and associated metro-station identifiers. These attributes provide facility capacities and transfer locations for multimodal transport simulation. The source says this dataset replaces tco-parcrelais-topologie-td, scheduled for withdrawal in January 2022. The separately catalogued live park-and-ride status dataset supplies availability and opening state. The topology inventory does not establish occupancy, vehicle turnover or the usable capacity on a particular day. Coverage follows the provider-described Rennes network. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The source specifies ODbL licensing. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related live park-and-ride status gives availability and opening state.
